notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes: Fixed a hole in the final level.

notes.title: Major Hotfix
notes.notes:
For some reason the game would boot and not show any text if you had previously installed the demo version, this should be fixed I apologize greatly for this issue I didn't even have any indication this could happen.

Their still might be a very rare bug where the game doesnt load fonts but that doesnt affect very many users at all. If this happens just install the fonts dev.ttf and dev2.ttf from the games main directory.
